default.notes: Apply for the e-visa at e-visa.gov.uz — USD 20, issued within about two working days, for a 30-day stay within 90-day validity.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under Uzbekistan's visa-waiver programme — accommodation registration still applies.
Visa-free under CIS-era bilateral agreements — stays are generous, but accommodation registration rules apply from the third day; confirm the exact allowance for your nationality.

UZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Uzbek citizens.

US.notes: US citizens need the USD 20 e-visa — except travellers aged 55 and over, who enter visa-free for up to 30 days.

KG.notes: Visa-free for up to 60 days under the bilateral agreement with Kyrgyzstan.

TJ.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under the 2018 bilateral agreement with Tajikistan.

CN.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under the China–Uzbekistan mutual waiver in force since mid-2025 — confirm before travel as implementation is recent.

AF.notes: Not eligible for the e-visa — apply through an Uzbek embassy; additional clearance is required and processing is slow.
